name: Swoop
description: Swoop finds X.com conversations most relevant to you, your startups, and your target market. It learns as you go, understanding which discussions deserve attention, , drafting highly contextual replies, and giving you an organized shared inbox when you need it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Swoop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Swoop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://getswoop.ai/api/plugin/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Swoop MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Swoop provides these MCP tools: get_briefing, get_conversation, get_workspace, save_reply_draft, search_conversations, and update_conversation_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Swoop?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Swoop in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Swoop requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Swoop is developed by Swoop. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
